changes: Subtitles: one tap picks or switches at once, tapping the one that plays turns it off, and dual subtitles are gone
MSone season packs give every episode its own file, and turning a subtitle off now clears the series memory too
A series you are watching fills its copies from every chat: open an episode and all its versions stand in the player
Episode names read one way everywhere: E10 at the start, a bare E10 and Episode 10 all stand as season 1, episode 10
Copies in the title's own original language stand first, and taking an episode with nothing chosen asks which copy to play
Versions rows name the file, Copies rows name the chat, and every theatre print (PreDVD, cam, telesync, telecine, screener, workprint) stays hidden
Search runs smoother and says it is still searching; cast pages mark what your chats hold and open it
notes: Subtitles are one tap again, MSone gives each episode its own file, and a series fills its copies from every chat.
